title: Choosing a Model, Shaping a Future: Comparing LLM Perspectives on Sustainability and its Relationship with AI

bias_targets.methodology: Administering validated psychometric questionnaires (AI-SDG17 and AISPI) using standardized prompts and 6-point Likert scales 100 times per model, along with an end-to-end strategic budget allocation task, to measure and compare model-expressed stances and ideological worldviews regarding sustainable development against a human baseline.
